summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of SNP Camps Phase 1. Created pytest suite (67 tests) covering health, auth/JWT/cookies/lockout, camps (one-active, print window), registration (validation, idempotency, Aadhaar mock, self-register), desk (presence-once, never_printed, PRINT_WINDOW_CLOSED), clinical (seen-only eligibility, transcription lock, append-only corrections, OT seats/slips), staff RBAC + password policy, KPIs/leaderboard/CSV exports. 64/67 backend tests pass. Frontend flows verified via Playwright on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): admin login/role-aware home, camp+day+print-window admin, Aadhaar mock scan with identity field locking, registration, A4 prescription print with QR + presence, mark-seen/never_printed refusal, clinical lookup (not_seen refusal without PHI), transcription -> lock -> correction, OT deferral seat consumption + 58mm slip, staff creation with password policy, leaderboards, CSV download, role guards for volunteer/clinical operator. 3 confirmed defects (1 critical, 2 high) plus UI issues.

critical.issue: 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes (routes_desk.py:113 `p['seen_at'] < now_utc() - timedelta(...)`). Mongo returns naive UTC datetimes. Undo-seen is completely broken (UI 'Undo' button always fails), and the 'blocked once a clinical transcription exists' invariant returns 500 instead of 409.

Brute-force lockout broken: routes_auth.py:36 compares naive `locked_until` from Mongo with aware now_utc() -> 500 instead of 429 (reproduced on localhost: 401,401,401,401,401,500,500). Additionally the rate-limit identifier is `client_ip:email` and the ingress forwards from multiple pod IPs (observed 10.208.134.66 and 10.208.134.70 for the same email), so attempts split across identifiers and the 5-attempt threshold is never reached through the public URL -> no effective lockout.

Endpoint requires staff auth (require_any) but the public patient self-registration page calls it on mount -> 401 -> the page renders only 'Not authenticated' and no form. Patient self-registration is entirely unusable. Needs a public read-only endpoint (e.g. GET /api/camps/active/public returning camp name/venue + today's day ids).

minor.issue: OT seat leak: existing fulfilment of the same item_type is deleted (line 206) without decrementing seats_taken on the previously booked ot_schedule_day. Re-recording/changing an OT deferral consumes an extra seat permanently.

Phone is optional server-side (null accepted) although the UI marks it required and the spec says required; validation inconsistent. Also is_dummy_phone() rejects any phone whose length != 10 including partial input, returning the same generic message.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True for a PHI application; recommend explicit origin list.
No TTL/cleanup index on login_attempts; lock documents accumulate forever.

ui_bugs.component: ui.js Modal (New Registration / Add Staff / Correction)
ui_bugs.issue: Modal panel renders partially ABOVE the viewport (measured bounding rect top = -32.5px, height 855 in a 1080px viewport). The sticky header with the title and the close 'X' is off-screen and un-clickable (Playwright: 'element is outside of the viewport'). Root cause: modal is not portaled to document.body, so `fixed inset-0` is resolved against a transformed/animated ancestor inside Layout. Body scroll is also not locked.

After submitting a correction the server value updates (verified in DB: bp 118/76 -> 150/95 + correction row) but the on-screen transcription form still shows the stale value; no refetch after correction.
React console error: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)' - navigate()/setState called during render.

integration_issues.issue: Page dead on arrival for unauthenticated patients: GET /api/camps/active returns 401 and the whole form is replaced by the 'Not authenticated' alert. Could not test receipt/QR through the UI (verified only via API).
Clicking Undo hits the 500 above; the row stays 'Seen' and the surfaced message is a generic axios error (no actionable text).

issues: Modal header/close button clipped above the viewport
Modal taller than viewport with no internal scroll reachable to the header
Bare page with only a red alert and 'Back to desk'; no header/branding, content pinned top-centre with large empty area

action_items: Fix naive/aware datetime comparisons: routes_desk.py:113 (undo-seen) and routes_auth.py:36 (lockout) — normalise Mongo datetimes to UTC-aware (or store/compare naive UTC consistently). Audit all other datetime comparisons.
Make login lockout proxy-safe: key on email (optionally plus X-Forwarded-For first hop) instead of raw request.client.host, and return 429 (currently 500).
Add a public (unauthenticated) endpoint for active camp/day info and use it in SelfRegister.js so /self-register works for patients.
Portal the Modal to document.body (createPortal) and lock body scroll so the modal header/close button is always visible and clickable.
Refetch the clinical record after a correction is submitted so the displayed transcription reflects the applied change.
Release the previously consumed OT seat (decrement seats_taken) when an OT deferral fulfilment is replaced/changed.
critical_code_review_comments: Any datetime read back from MongoDB is naive; every direct comparison with helpers.now_utc() (aware) raises TypeError at runtime — two such bugs already reach production paths (undo-seen, login lockout). Add a helper `as_utc(dt)` and use it everywhere.

routes_clinical.record_fulfilment deletes the prior fulfilment of the same item_type without compensating side effects (OT seat), breaking the seat-count invariant that the $expr conditional increment is meant to protect.
Brute-force protection keyed on request.client.host is meaningless behind the k8s ingress (multiple proxy IPs observed for one client).
SelfRegister.js depends on an authenticated endpoint — the public route has no unauthenticated data source; add a public projection that exposes no PHI.
ui.js Modal relies on `fixed inset-0` while rendered deep inside Layout; use a portal to avoid containing-block surprises (already breaking today).

Prescription print/mark-seen refusals return structured detail objects, but the frontend only renders detail.message/code — 500s (plain text) surface as raw axios messages; add a generic fallback message.

Run: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. rca_of_the_issue: 1) undo-seen + login lockout 500s: PyMongo/Motor return naive UTC datetimes; the code compares them directly with timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) -> TypeError -> 500 (traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at routes_desk.py:113). 2) Lockout never triggers over the public URL because request.client.host is the ingress pod IP which rotates, splitting the per-identifier counter. 3) /self-register is blank because the page bootstraps from the staff-only GET /api/camps/active (401). 4) Modal header off-screen because the fixed-position modal is nested inside Layout instead of being portaled, so its containing block is an ancestor with a transform/animation, giving the panel a negative top offset.
